talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 43 solo PCPs winding down in Virginia; 5 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Falls Church 22044, Annandale 22003, Chesapeake 23320) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~5,391 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.

**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Carroll County, Buckingham County, Dinwiddie County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 13 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~174,000 patients across 145 at-risk practices statewide.
